dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Hmph... This place is as noisy as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here, Celaeno?

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Just running errands for our parents. They want me to escort their precious human daughter back to the countryside for her regular treatments. That's all.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: We haven't set out yet, so I figured I'd stop by the Zapolyarnyn to pick up a few things.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: Linnea rarely gets the chance to come to Snezhnograd. It's only right that I bring back a few souvenirs for her and her Jack Frost.

dialogues.speaker: Celaeno
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, the Capital is far too loud for my liking. It's impossible to find any peace here. She's right to stay away.
